text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, her body is ready to compete even 
in Senior Gâ s. Receiving her Trainer's 
seal of approval, Tamamo Cross is 
overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, in the Classic division one 
year below, her roommate and close friend, 
Oguri Cap, was embarking on an unstoppable 
winning streak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross finds herself intensely drawn 
to Oguri Cap's strangely captivating 
running style...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined not to give up, she advanced to 
the Hanshin Daishoten as a stepping stone 
toward the Tenno Sho (Spring) that her 
father so admired.
